facts.text: Fairmont Golden Prague blends brutalist grandeur with Czech artistry and modern elegance.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Golden Prague blends brutalist grandeur with Czech artistry and modern elegance.

facts.text: The hotel has Prague's only indoor/outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: dive into Prague’s only indoor/outdoor pool or challenge yourself in the gym and group fitness studio.

facts.text: The hotel has six restaurants and bars serving Czech, Asian and European flavors, including Zlatá Praha, Greenhouse and the rooftop bar Golden Eye.
facts.excerpt: Savor Czech, Asian, and European flavors in six elegant yet relaxed venues, including Zlatá Praha, Greenhouse, and rooftop bar Golden Eye.

facts.text: The hotel is set in a brutalist building from 1974.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Golden Prague, set in a brutalist classic from 1974

facts.text: The building was designed by Czech architect Karel Filsak and originally opened as the InterContinental Prague.
facts.excerpt: Originally designed by Czech architect Karel Filsak, it opened as the InterContinental Prague

facts.text: The fine-dining restaurant Zlata Praha is on the top floor and has views over the spires and towers of the Old Town.
facts.excerpt: the fine-dining restaurant, Zlata Praha, is set on the top floor and has unimpeachable views over the spires and towers of the Old Town

facts.text: The spa has three saunas, a steam room, and treatment rooms for massages and facials.
facts.excerpt: there are three saunas and a steam room, as well as treatment rooms for massages and facials

facts.text: The spa offers a signature Czech Crystal Beauty facial, a 90-minute treatment that uses crystals.
facts.excerpt: including the signature Czech Crystal Beauty facial, an intricate 90-minute treatment that uses crystals to soothe away stress

facts.text: Breakfast is served in the Kafka Brasserie.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast is served in the Kafka Brasserie

facts.text: The first-floor Greenhouse serves an all-day menu of beer-hall favorites.
facts.excerpt: The first-floor Greenhouse, meanwhile, coaxes locals in with an all-day menu of beer-hall favorites

facts.text: The Old Town Square is a short walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: From the hotel it’s only a short walk down to the Old Town Square

facts.text: The Vltava River can be walked along or crossed to reach Prague Castle.
facts.excerpt: In the other direction is the Vltava River, which you can walk along or cross over to reach Prague Castle

facts.text: Rooms have a 55 inch TV, Nespresso machine, Dyson Supersonic hair dryer and Le Labo bathroom amenities.
facts.excerpt: Rooms feature a 55 inch TV, Nespresso machine, The Dyson Supersonic hair dryer and Le Labo bathroom amenities.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold rooms are on the high floors, with private check-in, concierge service and access to an exclusive lounge.
facts.excerpt: Located on the high floors, with access to Fairmont Gold including private check-in, concierge service and access to exclusive lounge.

facts.text: Studio residences have an open concept with a walk-in closet and a fully equipped kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Elegantly designed studios with an open concept featuring a walk-in closet, a fully equipped kitchen.

facts.text: The Fairmont Brunch has a supervised kids' corner with activities.
facts.excerpt: Little ones will love the supervised kids’ corner with fun activities.

facts.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee

facts.text: Pets are welcome but not permitted within the restaurant, spa and bar premises.
facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at Fairmont Golden Prague. Please note that pets are not permitted within the restaurant, spa and bar premises.

facts.text: Bedrooms use geometric fabrics on cushions and carpet, and bathrooms are carved from warm stone.
facts.excerpt: bedrooms use color sparingly but draw deep on texture and pattern, with geometric fabrics on cushions and carpet, and bathrooms carved from warm stone
